attributes.name: Joram Vhane
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each character at this location summons and encounters this adventure's servitor demon. If all demons are defeated, the difficulty to defeat Joram Vhane is decreased by 5.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from, and you may draw a random non-Basic armor from the box.
